title: Maussan sues the Peruvian government for $300 million

tellings.quote: I will have to remember I I put a lawsuit against them for $300 million.

tellings.difference: Told by journalist Pavel, who says the lawsuit forced the Ministry of Culture and the government to take the case more seriously; no dollar figure is given.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Jaime Maussan's lawsuit against the Peruvian government in 2024-2025. This telling adds what the suit is said to have achieved.

as_told.title: Lawsuit forces the Peruvian government to take the case seriously

plain: Jaime Maussan, a man who has championed the strange three-fingered bodies found in Peru, says he sued the Peruvian government for 300 million dollars over its handling of them, sometime in 2024 or 2025. Maussan says it himself: "I put a lawsuit against them for $300 million." A journalist named Pavel also tells it, without giving a figure, saying the lawsuit "forced the Peruvian Ministry of Culture and the Peruvian government to take this a little more seriously." If so, the case pushed officials to look harder at the bodies.
